status: PROTOTYPE service-space scenarios; electronics, thermal and hydraulic feasibility remain unqualified

pixel.max_chain_chips,max_chain_modules.rationale: Homogeneous chains capped at32chips AND16physical modules:8quads,16doubles,16singles. A1/A2 powering remains unqualified; group locally and never merge families.

pixel.ancillary_chain_area_mm2.rationale: Round larger prototype bounding area8.87*3.65=32.3755mm2 to35. Includes supply AND return,HV,monitoring,interlock; not copper area.

pixel.differential_link_area_mm2.rationale: 1.12+/-0.08 by0.71+/-0.08mm twinax outer dimensions; simultaneous upper product0.948mm2 rounded to1.0mm2.

pixel.feed_outer_diameter_mm,return_oute.rationale: 4mm OD transport feed and exhaust; exceeds local evaporator and3mm-ID exhaust scale. Both legs counted.

pixel.power_per_chip_W.rationale: (0.5electronics+0.1sensor+0.1services)W/cm2 times3.84cm2 active matrix=2.688W. This conditional TDR-density proxy is not RD53i qualification.

pixel.cooling_power_per_circuit_W.rationale: 300W demonstrated example motivates a grouping ceiling, not transfer of hydraulic qualification. Split independently within each local group.

strip.max_modules_per_harness,power_cabl.source: SRC-CMS-TDR-014 PDF35 section3.2.4 and PDF91 Table5.1; DES-010-strip-services SS-F10/F11
strip.max_modules_per_harness,power_cabl.rationale: Use documented12-module cable grouping and13.4/3.6mm outer envelopes as nODD geometric benchmark, not installed nODD cable design. Each long pair counts once.

strip.short_barrel_modules_per_leaf,long.source: DES-010-strip-services routing benchmarks; DES-009 retained row counts; SS-F03
strip.short_barrel_modules_per_leaf,long.rationale: Cap short/long half-staves at14/13 complete modules and endcap groups at12. Hydraulic design not established. Round perhalf-stave or radialrow.

strip.leaf_feed_outer_diameter_mm,leaf_r.rationale: Use2.5mmOD local interfaces for both legs. Leaf tubing is separate from larger downstream trunks.

strip.max_leaves_per_trunk,trunk_feed_ou.source: SRC-ATLAS-TDR-025 section11.4 printed263-265/PDF289-291; SRC-CMS-TDR-014 PDF91 Table5.1
strip.max_leaves_per_trunk,trunk_feed_ou.rationale: At most8leaf loops per bank within one layer and signedend;8/12mmOD feed/return comparator. No hydraulic validation implied.

strip.short_reference_module_power_W,lon.rationale: 7.8W completePS and5.4W complete2S comparator loads. Longpair not counted twice. Excludes additional sensorHV worst-case and not a qualified strixel load.

capacity.boundary_allowance_mm.rationale: 2mm reserved at each boundary in the cross-section. Mechanical/interface allowance; no claim measured manufacturing tolerance.

scenarios.available_phi_fraction,packing.rationale: Reference75%azimuth/50%packing; adverse50%azimuth/40%packing/+25%demand. Void fractions are not material densities.

scenarios.pixel_uplinks_per_module,pixel.source: SRC-ATLAS-TDR-030 section10.3.1 PDF263 and Table10.2 PDF266; DES-010-pixel-services PX-SF04
scenarios.pixel_uplinks_per_module,pixel.rationale: OneCMD perphysicalmodule; reference1uplink/module, conservative1/chip, stress4/chip. Actual occupancy/bandwidth unresolved.

scenarios.short_harness_multiplier.source: DES-007 I02; SRC-CMS-TDR-014 section3.3.2.2 PDF42; DES-010-strip-services
scenarios.short_harness_multiplier.rationale: 122880/30208 connected-channel ratio; explicitly rough power/datahousing stress only. Nominal cooling retained optimistically, so passing stressarea cannot qualify cooling.
